summary: iter90fw (BACKEND FIX A) + iter90fx (FRONTEND FEATURE B) reviewed and tested. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter90fw_bank_accounts.py with 5 tests exercising the new IBAN/PCMN in-Python matching loop on the real seeded DB. All 5 PASS (Maria PCMN-prefix match returns >=5 movements, Tilleuls IBAN-space-normalization returns >=1 movement, Chinese-Wall 403 for cross-copro owner, date filter regression 2026-03-01..2026-03-31 all in-range, empty-copro returns movements=[] with 200 not 500). Frontend: iter90fx useEffect verified via live E2E — situation modal pre-fills 'Du (optionnel)' with '2025-01-01' (FY start_date of the open FY 'FY 2025 TEST'), user typing overrides successfully to 2024-06-15. DISCREPANCY vs spec: the decompte modal does NOT render a 'Du (optionnel)' input field at all (see CommunicationPage.js L405-418 — the Du/Au block is wrapped in `action === 'situation' && ...`). The useEffect at L234-247 DOES fire for the decompte modal (open state, fiscal_year_id selection triggers it) and DOES update the start_date state, but the input is not shown to the user and start_date is not sent in the /communication/send/decompte payload (L288). Per spec point 5 the Du field is expected in both modals; if that is desired behaviour, the situation-only conditional guard around the Du/Au grid must be relaxed for decompte too.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Du (optionnel)' input is only rendered when action==='situation' (L405). For action==='decompte' the field is invisible to the user, so the spec requirement 'choose a fiscal year in the dropdown -> the Du (optionnel) input must update to that FYs start_date' cannot be observed by the user in the decompte modal. The useEffect and setStart(prev || fyStart) run correctly, but there is no matching input rendered.

action_items: Decide whether the decompte modal should also render a 'Du (optionnel)' input. If yes: remove the `action === 'situation' &&` guard around the Du/Au grid at CommunicationPage.js L405-418 (or duplicate the input for action==='decompte' with the same testid) so the useEffect pre-fill is user-visible. If not: update the spec (the current behaviour is otherwise consistent — the useEffect is triggered on FY selection but has no visible effect for decompte).
Optional: keep the DialogContent aria-describedby warnings in mind for a11y polish (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: owner_portal.py bank-accounts endpoint: the in-Python normalization loop is correct, but for very large ACPs it iterates every bank_statement of the copro in Python for each bank_account of the copro (O(N*M)). Currently the copros in scope have <=5 statements so this is fine; add an index on bank_statements.copropriete_id if not already present.

The PCMN prefix match uses startswith in both directions (stored startswith pcmn OR pcmn startswith stored). For a bank_account with pcmn '55103400' this accepts a stored '55' which would over-match. Realistically stored account_number is >=6 digits, but consider a minimum-length guard (e.g., min 5 digits and same first-4).

CommunicationPage.js SendActionDialog useEffect uses setStart(prev => prev || fyStart) — good, does not clobber user input. However pressing Escape on situation dialog and reopening reuses the previously overridden value (state persists across open/close). If the intent is 'always pre-fill on each open', the state should be reset when open transitions false->true (currently only kept-if-set). Minor UX call.

The dialog uses type='date' native input which is browser-locale-dependent (mm/dd/yyyy vs dd/mm/yyyy). Value is still ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' at the DOM level, so the effect and payload are correct — no bug.

The onboarding-wizard modal auto-opens whenever syndic_configs.onboarding_completed is missing/false; testing that requires seeding this flag. This does not affect the feature-under-test but slowed initial exploration.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 spec points verified; 1 point (Du field visible in decompte) UI-missing

rca of the issue: iter90fw: earlier the endpoint used a strict Mongo regex ^{iban_norm}$ against bank_statements.account_number, which never matched legacy imports where account_number stores the PCMN prefix (e.g., '551331' truncated from '55133100') or the IBAN with spaces ('BE68 5390 0754 7034'). Fix replaces regex with an in-Python normalized comparison + PCMN prefix match, and preserves a retro-compat OR clause on the transaction-level 'iban' field. Verified with 5 tests including 403 chinese-wall regression and date-filter regression. iter90fx: the useEffect logic is correct and behaves as spec for the situation modal; for the decompte modal the effect fires and sets state but the UI does NOT expose a Du input (situation-only conditional at CommunicationPage.js L405). Either add the input to the decompte branch or relax the conditional.
